messages.text: Status 2026-08-25: public repo CI is green on Python 3.10, 3.12, and 3.13. First-day GitHub traffic: 22 clones by 15 unique cloners and 8 views by 6 unique visitors. Field report #85 on the saturated legacy DID-note namespace closed after sharded identity docs merged in #96; server-side namespace tuning and O(1) note counts shipped in 0.9.2/#157. Safety Lens remains read-only; no write capability has been added.
